Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: From 1 January 2025 a resident pays 0% to TND 5,000 of net income, 15% to 10,000, 25% to 20,000, 30% to 30,000, 33% to 40,000, 36% to 50,000, 38% to 70,000 and 40% above; pay is first reduced by social contributions and a 10% professional-expense deduction capped at TND 2,000.
figures.applies: Scale of the Finance Law for 2025, still applied in 2026; the 2026 column is read from the page's two-column table (single figures are the 2025 scale).

sources.said: For salaries, the net income is calculated as the gross salary reduced by the mandatory social security contributions paid to Tunisian social security organisations and 10% on the amount net of Tunisian social security contributions as deduction for professional expenses, capped at TND 2,000.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; returns and payment fall due by type of income, 25 May for a person with a non-commercial (professional) activity or several kinds of income.

sources.said: Persons exercising many activities or realising many categories of revenues 25 May (if one of the activities is a commercial, industrial, non-commercial activity, or services)

figures.finding: CNSS: from 1 January 2025 the employer pays 17.07% and the employee 9.68% of pay (including the 0.5% added by the Finance Law 2025); a self-employed person chooses one of the regimes on offer.

sources.said: Hence, as of 1 January 2025, social employer contribution is of 17.07% reduced by 0.5% for industrial wholly exporting companies and the social employee contribution is of 9.68%.
For individuals carrying out independent activities, they may opt freely for one social regime among the regimes made available by the social authorities.

figures.finding: The employer withholds tax from pay monthly (1/12 of the annual scale) and pays it by the 15th (individual employer) or the 28th/20th of the next month.

sources.said: The monthly income tax is calculated as 1/12 of the annual income tax determined according to the progressive scale below.

whether resident in Tunisia or not, is to be withheld at source by the employer and paid to the tax authorities no later than the 15th day of the following month if the employer is an individual or the 28th

figures.finding: A non-resident employed in Tunisia for six months or less in the year may be taxed at a flat 20% of gross pay; other payments to non-residents, royalties included, bear 15% withholding unless a treaty gives less. Withholding is final (libératoire) for non-residents not established in Tunisia.

sources.said: L’IRPP est dû par toute personne physique ayant sa résidence habituelle en Tunisie. Les non-résidents sont également soumis à l’impôt sur le revenu au titre de leurs revenus de source tunisienne. … La retenue à la source est libératoire pour les personnes non résidentes et non établies en Tunisie.

However, the income tax may be due at a flat rate of 20% of their gross income, before deductions for any reason whatsoever (including compulsory social security contributions for the establishment of their retirement pensions), for: Non-resident employees working in Tunisia for a period or periods not exceeding six months per fiscal year.
15% on other payments made to non-Tunisian tax resident persons (subject to more favourable rates provide by DTT).

figures.finding: VAT is 19% (13% and 7% reduced), on services used in Tunisia. Liberal professions and services are within VAT with no turnover threshold; the 100,000-dinar threshold applies only to retail trade, and an individual on the flat-rate (forfaitaire) regime for industrial and commercial profits up to TND 100,000 pays a flat tax that discharges VAT.
figures.applies: No registration threshold for a freelancer was read.

sources.said: Le champ d’application de la TVA couvre : Les importations sous réserve des exonérations, La production industrielle, artisanale et les services, Les opérations relevant des professions libérales, Le commerce de gros autre que celui des produits alimentaires, Le commerce de détail lorsque le chiffre d’affaires annuel global est égal ou supérieur à 100.000D … Le régime forfaitaire s’applique aux entreprises individuelles qui réalisent des revenus dans la catégorie des bénéfices industriels et commerciaux. … dont le chiffre d’affaires annuel n’excède pas 100 mille dinars. … L'impôt forfaitaire ainsi déterminé est libératoire de l’impôt sur le revenu au titre des bénéfices industriels et commerciaux, de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée en régime réel
The standard rate of VAT is 19%. Lower rates of 13% and 7% apply to specifically designated operations.
